summary: Completed testing of 3 new features for Parking Reservation App: 1) User booking stats endpoint, 2) Auto no-show background task, 3) QR button on dashboard. All backend and frontend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/reservations/stats correctly returns stats object with all required keys (total, pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed, no_show)
Auto no-show background task runs every 5 minutes and correctly marks pending reservations past their end_time as no_show
Dashboard QR button has proper data-testid attribute (dashboard-qr-btn-{id}) and opens dialog with QR code image
History tab in Reservations page shows booking stats cards matching the actual reservation counts
Stats values are non-negative and total equals sum of all status counts
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: 1) GET /api/reservations/stats returns user's booking stats by status, 2) auto_mark_no_shows background task marks pending reservations with past dates/times as no_show (runs every 5 min), 3) Dashboard QR buttons (data-testid='dashboard-qr-btn-{id}') open QR dialog. Stats endpoint requires auth. History tab shows 5 stat cards (Total, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled, No-Show). Active tab has both QR and Cancel buttons on reservation rows.
